g.text: National rice yield, % deviation from each country's long-run trend
19% of the worst 10% of rice harvests came in El Niño onset years,
which make up 30% of all years
Source: FAOSTAT QCL rice yields (release 2025-12-31); NOAA CPC ONI (accessed 2026-11-20). Shortfall: national
yield at least 5% below its long-run trend. Cambodia from 1980.
